title: Joint MLP recode improves the frontier with confidence but misses the cumulative v7 guide
interpretation: The frozen bundle produces statistically supported improvements over the accepted frontier in every v7 domain, including a 0.43% relative NLL reduction on SQuAD, but cumulative SQuAD remains 1.00467 and therefore misses the predeclared 1.00217 publication guide. The bundle is retained as a development starting point but is not published as a checkpoint; v7 will not be used for further tuning.
